notes: Source: Sega Saturn Instruction Manual (1995, Sega, US; archive.org Sega_Saturn_Instruction_Manual_1995_Sega_US), section «The Sega Saturn Control Pad», «Button Controls» items 1–7, read as the pad's complete control list. Quotes retain the maker manual's archive.org OCR text and spacing; the cited control facts were checked against rendered page images (PDF/printed page 12, Button Controls items 1–7) on 2026-11-01. The page image is authoritative where OCR differs. Mapping: D-Pad = dpad 1; A, B, C, X, Y, Z = face_button 6; Left/Right Shift Buttons (L, R) = bumper 2; Start = button 1. wired=true: the pad connects to a Control Port. This is the US-launch pad of that manual; the later Japanese-style pad shares the layout but no source here says it shares the shell. Body dimensions, mass, cord length: no maker or museum figure found, null. Sega's history archive is 403 (not retried).
